Lightning Breath: Each creature in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on failure or half on success. Repulsion Breath: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be pushed 60 feet away.
